items.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
items.title_zh: Whistle：仅 16.9 MB 的本地语音转文本模型
items.title_en: Whistle: A 16.9 MB Local Speech-to-Text Model
items.summary: Whistle is a 16.9 MB speech-to-text model presented as a tiny, locally runnable STT solution, sparking discussion about accuracy, streaming capabilities, and edge deployment.

items.title: ThinkingBox: Solving an agent task once vs. solving it 20/20: 507 stateful workflows graded on terminal database state [R]
items.title_zh: ThinkingBox：507 个有状态工作流基准，用终态数据库状态衡量智能体可靠性
items.title_en: ThinkingBox: a 507-workflow benchmark grading agent reliability on terminal database state
items.summary: ThinkingBox introduces a 507-workflow benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents reliably solve stateful business tasks across repeated attempts and end in correct terminal database/backend states.

items.title: 中国科学家研制成功核光钟
items.title_zh: 中国清华大学团队研制成功世界首台运行中的核光钟
items.title_en: China's Tsinghua Team Builds World's First Operating Nuclear Clock
items.summary: Chinese scientists at Tsinghua University built and stably operated the world's first nuclear clock based on thorium-229 nuclear transitions, publishing the result in Nature.

items.title: Stripe 同意收购 OpenRouter，覆盖 80 多家提供商的 400 多个模型  Stripe 于 2026 年 8 月 19 日宣布已同意收购 AI
items.title_zh: Stripe 同意收购 OpenRouter，涵盖 400 多个模型的 AI 网关
items.title_en: Stripe Agrees to Acquire OpenRouter, the 400+ Model AI Gateway
items.summary: Stripe announced it has agreed to acquire OpenRouter, the AI model gateway that dynamically routes requests across 400+ models from 80+ providers.

items.title: Mistral 发布 1 万亿参数模型  法国 AI 公司 Mistral 于 10 月 6 日发布 Mistral Large 4（又称“le Chonk”）
items.title_zh: Mistral 发布 1 万亿参数模型 Mistral Large 4
items.summary: Mistral announced Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter open-source-focused model trained on 4000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs, targeting cybersecurity, coding, finance, manufacturing, and multimodal tasks.

items.title: OpenAI API 新增 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式
items.title_zh: OpenAI 在 Responses API 中为 GPT-6.1 Sol 新增 Ultrafast 模式
items.title_en: OpenAI adds Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API
items.summary: OpenAI added an Ultrafast mode for GPT-6.1 Sol in the Responses API, offering up to 8x generation speed at 6x Standard pricing.
